title: Federated Foundation Models Raise New Concerns of Robustness, Privacy, and Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis evaluating how inherent demographic biases (such as gender, race, and age) from foundation models are transmitted to and amplified in federated learning systems via synthetic data generation and knowledge distillation.

Conceptual assessment of 'participate resource disparity', evaluating how unequal distribution of computational power, memory, connectivity, and funding among federated learning clients leads to systemic unfairness and aggregation bias.
